methodologyNotes: Official pricing pages re-verified via WebFetch on 2026-06-18 (stora.co/pricing, storeganise.com/pricing, kinnovis.com/pricing, storable.com/products/edge, sitelink.com/products/web-edition, 6storage.com/self-storage-management-software). storageunitsoftware.com/pricing returned HTTP 403 to automated fetch, so Easy Storage Solutions (now branded 'Storable Easy' after the 2020 Storable merger) pricing was confirmed via Capterra's vendor-supplied listing ($90/mo flat). Five of seven vendors publish NO dollar/GBP amounts on their official pricing pages (Stora, Kinnovis, Storable Edge, SiteLink, 6Storage) — for these, monthlyUsd is set to null. A null beats a guess. Stora shows three named tiers (Essentials/Advanced/Premium) but no currency amounts on the page; the £99/£149/£299 GBP figures are from third-party aggregators (Capterra/SoftwareSuggest) and are recorded in plan notes only, never in monthlyUsd. Storeganise is the only vendor with a self-serve published price ($100/mo monthly, $90/mo annual for 1-100 units). 6Storage's official page explicitly disclaims fixed pricing; its 'Good-Better-Best' is a feature operators offer THEIR customers, not 6Storage's own tiers — the draft's three priced sub-plans were consolidated into one honest custom-quote plan. accessedAt 2026-06-18.

vendors.name: Stora
vendors.provenance: Three named tiers (Essentials/Advanced/Premium) confirmed on stora.co/pricing on 2026-06-18, but the official page publishes NO currency amounts (it states only 'Pricing starts at 50 units' and offers annual billing = 2 months free). monthlyUsd set to null for all tiers. GBP figures (£99/£149/£299) are third-party aggregator data (Capterra/SoftwareSuggest) recorded in notes only. Free trial confirmed ('Try it free' CTA, duration unpublished). Integrations from stora.co/integrations. Compliance not disclosed on any public page.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Official stora.co/pricing publishes no currency amount; third-party aggregators (Capterra) list £99/month GBP. Up to 5 team members. Minimum 50 units. Includes website, online bookings, recurring payments, online check-in, contracts, basic CRM and reporting. Annual billing = 2 months free (~17%).

plans.name: Advanced
plans.notes: Official page publishes no currency amount; third-party aggregators list £149/month GBP. Up to 10 team members. Minimum 50 units. Everything in Essentials plus dynamic pricing, automated price increases, overlocking, advanced reporting, upsells, insurance tools, debt collections, Public API, Zapier. Annual billing = 2 months free.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Official page publishes no currency amount; third-party aggregators list £299/month GBP. Unlimited team members. Minimum 50 units. Everything in Advanced plus custom roles, phone & priority support, quarterly growth manager check-ins, extended API rate limits. Annual billing = 2 months free.
